findings.title: BW organic uses are not carried by the two listed property partners
findings.why: The whole source requires explaining uses in everyday life and technology from properties for the stated organic substances. fcc73fb5 describes/classifies properties and 3d3231f9 explains melting, boiling and solubility through interactions. Neither listed original partner requires the property-to-use explanation. The BW actual target set also lacks the retained petroleum-use atom b95cdf98. Equal atomic sets do not supply this missing operative role.
findings.limit: This is a bounded source-role coverage hold. It does not assert that all chemistry applications require a new atom or career instruction.
findings.minimalRemedy: Provide and bind an existing retained goal/operator witness that actually covers the organic property-to-use examples, or retain a narrowly scoped source role until that witness exists.

findings.title: BW experiment planning, actual conduct and protocol duties remain unbound
findings.why: 3.2.1.1(1) requires experimental investigation, whereas fcc73fb5 only describes/orders properties. 3.2.2.1(2) expressly requires plan, conduct, protocol and contextual interpretation; bcf8b24b and the combustion-family children chiefly interpret reactions, air and extinguishing. 3.2.2.2(2) requires actual mass-conservation/mass-ratio experiments and guided evaluation; 1bdaf7f2 evaluates/explains and e0d05c36 recognizes/describes ratios. The separation partner 5a709938 does carry separating and justified procedure choice, but its actual independent planning witness is not bound. These are separate operators, not a numerical-data or safety substitute.
findings.limit: No actual human experiment is required to assert a candidate; an assessable AI-authored procedural route and exact physical partner duties must exist. This review does not claim any experiment was performed.
findings.minimalRemedy: Preserve a scoped plan/conduct/protocol route and bind the precise retained practical/operator partners; inspect its whole task and moderator protocol rather than only target IDs.

findings.title: HH societal-development/knowledge links are not equivalent to decision appraisal
findings.why: The source explicitly asks for links between societal developments and chemical knowledge. 1df17884 requires criterion-led opportunities/risks and decision reflection. Its full DE/EN text does not require explaining the historical or developmental relation between knowledge and society. The second argumentation duty can be exercised by justified criterion-led appraisal, but this does not cover the first duty.
findings.limit: Only this opaque role is held; no new defect is asserted for the accepted decision goal itself.
findings.minimalRemedy: Bind a retained whole knowledge-development/application witness for the exact HH stage, or keep this source component pending.

findings.title: HH elevated polarimetry has no retained operative partner
findings.why: The actual elevated-only protein table requires the general polarimetry principle. 3d3231f9,747c5777,eb7537dd concern intermolecular forces, electrostatic bond/molecular polarity and properties. Plane-polarized light rotation/optical activity is not molecular dipole polarity. The separate canonical f4d5a02d does have a suitable polarimetry description, but it is absent from this actual candidate target set and absent from the original duty partner list. Chromatography/Rf coverage by 978a6f25 is preserved.
findings.limit: No polarimetry experiment or quantitative rotation calculation is made universal; the stated source only needs the general principle here.
findings.minimalRemedy: Bind the existing suitable polarimetry goal into the actual elevated HH source/view scope, preserving original history and the narrower duty.

findings.title: MV metallic-current source role is not established by ionic-lattice partners
findings.why: The actual compulsory content distinguishes a driving voltage source, moving electrons and vibrating metal ions. The listed original partners 4285d84a,950c73c6,a1632ea9 concern ions in solutions, ionic lattices and ion formation. A metal is not an ionic crystal with mobile ions. The actual retained fcaf8c9b metal-model goal is useful counterevidence and must not be erased, but this duty currently has no exact binding or operative witness for its voltage/electron/vibration mechanism. Its mere target presence cannot certify the full original role.
findings.limit: This is a targeted source-binding hold, not a claim that the retained metal-model goal is scientifically wrong or that no retained goal could remedy it.
findings.minimalRemedy: Bind a scientifically correct retained metallic-current model witness for voltage, electron motion and lattice vibration to this exact original duty. No image generation is indicated.

findings.title: RP selected photometry and compulsory complex applications are not carried by the listed retained atoms

Independently, actual P9.1 explicitly requires applications of complex formation at at least two selected examples; redox/polymer/catalysis/silver partners do not carry a named coordination-complex application route. The page36 IR/NMR/GC-MS etc extensions and page73 extensions are not made universal. The hold does not require both alternative environmental paths or every extension.
findings.minimalRemedy: Restore the real P/W/extension/page/course frame and bind the exact selected photometry route and the two-example P9.1 complex application witness. Keep other original roles and original decisions unchanged as history.
